steps.content: Even your shackles can't pierce through the layers of vines binding you. Immobilized and unable to cry out, you can do nothing but watch.

Another failing beam snaps and crashes to the ground with a dull thud, quickly devoured by the raging flames. Forced to watch from afar, you can only witness the contamination spread while the air fills with the shrieks of the maddened and the dying's desperate wails.
Yingying rushes back and forth between the ruins and the entrance, carrying out the "people" trapped within, one after another, laying them by the roadside.
Despite the distance between you, her labored breathing and sobs travel clearly to your ears through the vines that bind you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Save us... Please...

She repeats these words over and over—like a mantra, a prayer, comfort for others, solace for herself. The Mania gathers around her as power awakens within, and the Corruptors now cower before her presence, keeping their distance, no longer daring to harm her.

But no one calls out to her anymore—the screams and wails have given way to an even more terrifying silence. Time seems to stretch endlessly as she stumbles, struggles to her feet, and limps on, each step slower than the last. Eventually, she collapses, unable to muster the strength to rise once more. Yet, she still crawls on, with nowhere to go.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Please...
As her consciousness fades, her plea finally receives an answer.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: ...Are you... afraid... Do you... resent this... Are you... angry... ...Are you... in despair...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: ...These were supposed to be... the happiest days... Why did it turn out like this... Why did it have to be us...
The chaotic voice rises from the void, slowly engulfing the entire street.
And she can no longer tell who is speaking.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...I don't understand... I don't want this...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: ...You... also want us to survive...
Her eyes can no longer see anything else but the wisteria in the center of the courtyard—

Her beginning, her childhood dreams, the roots she had relied on for years—all have grown monstrously large. The lives it absorbed are now intertwined, burning with a manic intensity, casting shadows of nothing but despair.
At this moment, the advent of their deity has finally come.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: Speak... tell us your wish...
Countless familiar voices ring in a chorus—the voices of those she couldn't save. They come to comfort her, accompany her, beseech her, threaten her, tempt her, corrupt her.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: O Wisteria Fairy above... I beg you...

Before Yingying can finish her words, the massive darkness seizes upon her daze and completely devours her. A tempest of Mania erupts ferociously, ensnaring you as well in an ever-tightening embrace of vines, cocooning you away from the outside world.
You catch a final utterance, not just from her voice but from an obsessive chorus of countless souls merged into one—

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: From this moment on, you are the Wisteria Fairy... Now go, continue our fete...
[Transition]
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I won't try to run away...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know what's happened, and I know nothing can change it anymore...
The vines wrapped around you slowly begin to loosen.
Before your eyes, the withered vines twist and weave themselves into a human shape, gradually taking the form of a figure you know all too well.
If you knew all this, then why did you come back?
